name: BRONYA // CYBER MAID
title: TACTICAL DRONE COMMANDER // HAXOR AUTOMATON
quote: Bronya has already calculated 1,024 outcomes. Victory rate: 99.98%.
lore: A masterpiece of micro-electronics and automated aerial reconnaissance. Equipped with twin photon-emitter wings and orbital drone links, Bronya manages battlefield telemetry while serving Earl Grey tea with absolute stoic poise.

abilities.name: Orbital Drone Swarm
abilities.desc: Commands 12 micro-drones for 360-degree radar surveillance and laser interception.

abilities.name: Quantum Firewall Hijack
abilities.desc: Decrypts enemy command protocols and redirects automated turrets within seconds.

abilities.name: Nanite Field Maintenance
abilities.desc: Instantly repairs armor damage and restores squad shield capacitors in combat.
